title: Strawberry and Vanilla Baked Alaska
summary: A dramatic centrepiece of frozen vanilla and strawberry ice cream wrapped in cake and a cloud of toasted meringue.

ingredients.item: plain pound cake (Madeira-style loaf), cut into 1 cm slices
large egg whites, at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Line a 23 cm bowl with cling film, leaving plenty of overhang to fold over later.

steps.title: Shell
steps.text: Soften 1.4 litres vanilla ice cream for 15 min, then press it over the base and up the sides to form an even 2-3 cm shell, and freeze for 1 h until firm.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Soften 1.4 litres strawberry ice cream for 15 min and spoon it into the centre, leaving 1 cm clear at the top.

steps.title: Cap
steps.text: Cover the surface with trimmed slices of the 340 g pound cake, fold the cling film over and freeze for at least 3 h (up to 72 h).

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: At least 3 h before serving, whisk 6 egg whites with ⅛ tsp cream of tartar until frothy and doubled, about 1 min, then add ¼ tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt and gradually whisk in 200 g caster sugar until the meringue holds stiff, glossy peaks.

steps.title: Unmould
steps.text: Dip the bowl in warm water for 15 s, turn the dome out onto a paper-lined tray cake-side down and peel away the film.

steps.title: Cover
steps.text: Spread or pipe the meringue all over the dome in spiky peaks with no gaps, then freeze uncovered for at least 2 h until firm.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C and bake for 3-5 min, watching closely until the peaks are browned (or use a blowtorch), then rest for up to 10 min before slicing into wedges with a knife wiped clean between cuts.

tips: Work quickly while assembling the ice cream layers so they stay firm enough to shape.
Keep the dome in the freezer right up until it goes in the oven, and bake it straight after it's fully frozen for the cleanest slices.
safety: If serving anyone pregnant, very young, elderly or unwell, use pasteurised egg whites, since the meringue is only lightly browned rather than fully cooked.
storage: Freeze the assembled dome, before adding the meringue, for up to 72 h; once browned, serve it straight away as it won't hold once sliced.
